verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents LangSmith issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys, such as permission-restricted or workspace-limited service keys for an agent. The closest item, Agent Auth, covers agents getting OAuth 2.0 access to external systems. That is a related but different capability, and it says nothing about scoping or least privilege, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
